name: soft-play
title: Soft Play
summary: Bold rounded display type, saturated colour blocks and big radii. For consumer apps, education, kids and casual games, events and friendly onboarding.
imagery: Flat colour shapes, cut-out objects on colour blocks, cheerful real photos; no 3D mascots, no clip art.
rules: Headlines in Unbounded 600-700, short and punchy; body in Rubik 400, 16 px.
Use the pop colours (pop-yellow, pop-pink, pop-mint) as large flat blocks behind content, never for text.
Text on pop colours is always the text colour; on the accent it is on-accent.
Generous radius: 20 px for cards, pill shapes (999) for buttons and chips.
Buttons are big (height 52 or more, 24 px side padding) with weight 500 labels.
Tilt or overlap at most one element per screen for energy; keep the rest on the grid.
No gradients and no drop shadows; depth comes from colour blocks.
